svg.aria-label: Two plots. Left: a scatter plot of side scatter against forward scatter with three clusters of cells, lymphocytes at low size and low granularity, monocytes larger, and granulocytes the most granular, with a rectangular gate round the lymphocytes. Right: a histogram of anti-CD4 fluorescence for the gated cells beside the unstained control, with a dashed threshold and the percentage of CD4-positive cells to the right of it.

g.title: events outside the gate: Cells outside the gate are not counted in the next plot.
events inside the gate: Cells inside the gate: the population chosen for analysis.
gate: A region drawn on the plot to select a population of cells.

svg.text: 2 Count the labelled cells in the gate

g.title: stained gated cells: Gated cells labelled with fluorescent anti-CD4 antibody.
unstained control: Unstained cells show the background fluorescence and set the threshold for a positive signal.
threshold: Set from the unstained control: only brighter cells count as positive.
